name: submit_html
description: Submit the complete HTML document produced for the task.

html.description: The complete standalone HTML document requested by the task.
html.title: Html

name: continue_html
description: Finish a document that was cut off, by echoing its final line and supplying the rest.

last_line.description: The final line of the document you already submitted, copied character for character. It is usually an incomplete line that stops mid-tag or mid-statement.
last_line.title: Last Line

continuation.description: Everything that still has to follow that final line, starting at the very next character after it and running to the end of the document. Do not repeat any part of last_line here, and do not repeat any earlier part of the document.
continuation.title: Continuation
